root_cause: Traffic spike (3x normal load) caused order-service pods to exceed their 1Gi memory limit, resulting in OOMKills (exit code 137). HPA did not scale fast enough due to memory-based scaling not configured.
contributing_factors: Memory limit of 1Gi insufficient for peak load
HPA only configured for CPU scaling, not memory
Memory usage reached 98-99% of limit before OOM
No circuit breaker or rate limiting to protect service
evidence: Traffic spike: 3x baseline at incident start
Multiple pods OOMKilled with exit code 137
Error rate 45% correlates with pod crashes
HPA min/max replicas: 3/20 but only 3 running

remediation.recommendation: Increase memory limit to 2Gi and add memory-based HPA scaling
steps: Increase memory limit from 1Gi to 2Gi in deployment
Add memory utilization target to HPA (80%)
Configure rate limiting at ingress (1000 req/s per pod)
Add circuit breaker for downstream dependencies
Monitor memory usage and adjust limits as needed
